title: 图表
summary: 「做个图表」只说了有数。先定要看变化、大小、占比、关系、流程还是能力，再选痕迹。
summaryEn: “Make a chart” only says there are numbers. First decide whether this data is for change, size, share, relation, flow, or ability — then pick the mark.
asksEn: What is this data for seeing?

links.when: 若数字要对着结果往下钻
links.whenEn: if the numbers must drill from the result
picking the mark is not drilling
